name: Kiryu Kuro
source:
Though he’s rugged-looking, he is good at sewing and handles making costumes. He is caring, manly, and overprotective of his little sister. With a powerful yet gentle singing voice, his performances are rough and brilliant.

A member of Rhythm Link’s AKATSUKI.

[From in-game profile]
